title: Best MCP servers for Claude — Desktop, Claude.ai, and Code
excerpt: Claude is three MCP clients. Claude.ai needs HTTPS connectors; Desktop and Claude Code can also run local stdio. Start with Influzer Discovery, then a small remote or coding stack — not a 20-server dump.
contentHtml:
People ask for the best MCP servers for Claude and expect one ranked list. Wrong frame.

Claude.ai only accepts remote HTTPS connectors. Claude Desktop can mix connectors and local stdio. Claude Code installs via claude mcp add (stdio or HTTP).

Start here:

  1. Connect Influzer MCP Discovery — search 6,000+ servers from inside Claude (setup).
  2. Remote starter for claude.ai: Discovery + Context7 + Neon or Sentry.
  3. Research/coding on Desktop or Code: Exa / Firecrawl, Playwright, issue trackers.

Cap at 4–6 servers on day one. Full stacks + checklist: Best MCP servers for Claude in 2026.
